subject: Change request: Convert intro demo into scoped POC workshop — availability & logistics
messages:
From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@finco.com>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finco.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro demo next week?

Thanks for the invite, Jonas. Quick update from our side — our CTO (Priya) will be traveling for a board meeting the week you proposed. After chatting internally we think an intro demo won't be enough: we'd prefer to convert the session into a 90–120 minute scoped POC workshop so engineering and security can validate integration surface area.

Two asks: 1) can we split the workshop into two 60-min blocks across two days to accommodate global participants? 2) we need a short prework checklist and an agenda to share with our infra team.

If that works, please send updated availability — mornings PST work best for us.

— Jordan
Head of ML Platform, FinCo Analytics
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@finco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 1 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change request: Convert intro demo into scoped POC workshop — availability & logistics

Jordan — appreciate the clarity and the ask. Totally fine to convert to a scoped POC workshop and split into two 60-minute blocks. Quick notes:

- We typically run the first session as discovery + integration surface mapping, second as live walkthrough + minimal hands-on scoping (auth, data flows, quotas).
- We'll provide a 1-page prework checklist (what to have on the call) and a draft agenda.
- For SSO/KMS questions we can pull Karthik in to cover security integration notes.

Proposed slots (all PST):
- Tue 10 Mar: 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00
- Wed 11 Mar: 09:00–10:00 or 11:00–12:00

If Priya is unavailable that week we can also do the week of Mar 20 but prefer to keep it sooner. I'll attach a first-pass agenda and checklist; Marissa will run the workshop.

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v1.pdf, prework-checklist.md

Thanks — Jonas
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finco.com>

Subject: Re: Change request: Convert intro demo into scoped POC workshop — availability & logistics

Jonas — thanks. Tue/Wed the 10/11 slots look good for engineering. Priya (CTO) will still be traveling but can join the second block by phone on Tue 10 Mar at 11:00 PST if that works.

Two small requests from security: please include a short diagram of SSO/KMS touchpoints and an example payload size estimate so we can flag any throughput concerns ahead of time.

Jordan & Jonas — confirming: Tue 10 Mar 11:00–12:00 PST (block A: discovery) and Wed 11 Mar 09:00–10:00 PST (block B: walkthrough + scoping). Priya will dial into block A on Tue at 11:15 PT and join fully for block B if the timezone permits.

— Priya

Agenda (short):
- Block A (Tue 10 Mar, 11:00–12:00 PST): discovery, goals, current infra, security constraints, endpoints mapping (owner: Marissa)
- Block B (Wed 11 Mar, 09:00–10:00 PST): live walkthrough, auth demo, basic throughput test plan, next steps/action owners (owner: Karthik)

Prework: please have a service account that can call your embeddings endpoint (or test stub) and an engineer on the call who knows your SSO provider config. If you prefer, we can run a short test with a sandbox token instead.

Looking forward to it. I'll also create a HubSpot meeting record and invite the engineering distribution list.
